evidence.sourceTitle: GRAIL announces filing of registration statement for proposed IPO
evidence.shortExcerpt: GRAIL announced an S-1 filing for a proposed IPO and applied to list common stock under GRAL.

observedFacts.statement: As of the 2020-09-09 release, GRAIL said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined.
GRAIL announced on 2020-09-09 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO.
GRAIL said it applied to list common stock on Nasdaq under ticker GRAL.

evidence.shortExcerpt: The S-1/A identifies GRAIL, describes late-stage Galleri and DAC development, and reports no generated revenues to date.

observedFacts.statement: GRAIL reported a USD 136.4 million net loss for the six months ended 2020-06-30.
Through 2020-06-30, GRAIL stated it had raised over USD 1.9 billion from venture and strategic partners.
GRAIL stated its foundational clinical trials had more than 115,000 subjects already enrolled.
GRAIL planned to commercially launch Galleri in 2021 as a laboratory developed test.
GRAIL stated it did not yet have a commercial product for sale.
GRAIL stated it had not generated revenues to date and did not expect revenues until products were commercialized.
The S-1/A identifies the registrant as GRAIL, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001699031.
